_comment: Fill these in using your browser's DevTools inspector. See README 'Finding your selectors'.
_shifts_comment: Verified against the live site while there were 0 open entries: the empty state renders a plain heading with no row markup at all (confirmed via page source), inside a '#main .col-sm-12' container. rowSelector below targets any non-heading element in that same container, so it matches nothing when empty and should pick up real rows once something is posted. idAttribute/fields are unverified best-effort guesses. If they don't match, monitor.js falls back to the row's full text, so alerts still fire and still include full details even before this gets tightened up. Re-check this against the live page next time an entry is posted, and adjust rowSelector and fields if needed.
